newsitem.title: MALAYSIA: KL blue chips close flat, 2nd board active.
newsitem.headline: KL blue chips close flat, 2nd board active.

text.p: Malaysian blue chip equities closed almost flat as investors focussed strongly on small-capitalised stocks, dealers and analysts said.
The blue-chip Composite Index was down 0.11 point to 1160.74, the all-share EMAS index was up 0.12 point to 334.71, and the Second Board index was up 8.11 points at 634.36
"There has been nothing to move the market in the short term," said Simon Maughan, head of research at W.I. Carr.
Technology Resources was down five cents to 6.05 ringgit. "Investors are concerned over TRI as a cellular (telephone) price war is heading closer and closer," said Maughan.

Malaysia Airlines was down 40 cents to 6.10 ringgit. Singapore Airlines' half-year results released recently were disappointing, and this has raised concerns over Malaysia Airlines' future profitablilty, said Maughan.

Overall volumes were thinner than previous trading sessions. A total of 261 million shares were traded, valued at 2.19 billion ringgit. Gainers led losers 302 to 245, with 158 stocks remaining unchanged.
U.S. funds had been active, but not aggressively, said an institutional dealer at a foreign brokerage house.
